response.sql: WITH votes AS (SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max FROM manager_award_vote), player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS death_country, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) AS player_average FROM votes AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 GROUP BY p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '')), country_averages AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(player_average) AS country_average FROM player_averages GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, country_average, country_average / (SELECT AVG(country_average) FROM country_averages) AS relative_to_country_mean FROM country_averages

assumptions.assumption: Award-vote records include both player and manager award votes.
NULL and empty-string death countries belong to the same blank group.

alternatives.interpretation: Award-vote records means only player award votes.
